chapitres.titreChapitre: Introduction to English Sounds and Greetings
chapitres.competenceChapitre: Master the English alphabet, basic pronunciation, greetings, and self-introduction

objectifsLesson.description: Recognize and pronounce all 26 letters of the English alphabet
Distinguish specific English sounds (th, h aspirated, r)
Practice minimal pairs to improve pronunciation
Spell names and simple words aloud
Use formal and informal greetings appropriately
Introduce oneself (name, age, nationality, occupation)
Ask and answer simple personal questions
Use polite expressions (please, thank you, excuse me)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Conjugate the verb 'to be', count from 1 to 100, and identify days, months, and colors

objectifsLesson.description: Conjugate 'to be' in present tense (am, is, are)
Form affirmative, negative, and interrogative sentences
Use contractions correctly (I'm, you're, he's)
Describe people and things using 'to be'
Count from 1 to 100 fluently
Name the days of the week and months of the year
Identify and name basic colors
Give personal information including age and birthday

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Name family members, use articles correctly, and form regular plurals

objectifsLesson.description: Name family members (father, mother, sister, brother, etc.)
Describe family relationships using possessive adjectives
Talk about one's family using simple sentences
Ask and answer questions about family
Use articles a, an, and the correctly
Form regular plural nouns (-s, -es, -ies)
Identify common irregular plurals (man/men, child/children)
Name everyday objects found in the home

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Name foods and drinks, use present simple with all persons, and order at a restaurant

objectifsLesson.description: Name common foods and beverages
Express food preferences (I like, I don't like)
Use present simple with I, you, we, they
Talk about meals and eating habits

lessons.titreLesson: Ordering at a Restaurant and Shopping

objectifsLesson.description: Order food and drinks at a restaurant
Use present simple with he, she, it
Name clothing items and accessories
Ask about prices and bargain at the market

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Name public places, use prepositions of location, and give directions

objectifsLesson.description: Name public places (hospital, school, market, church, bank)
Use prepositions of place (next to, opposite, between, behind)
Describe the location of places in town
Ask where places are located
Ask for directions politely (Excuse me, where is...?)
Give simple directions (turn left, go straight, turn right)
Name means of transportation
Understand and follow spoken directions

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Describe weather conditions, name seasons, and ask questions with do/does

objectifsLesson.description: Describe weather conditions (sunny, rainy, hot, cold)
Name the four seasons and their characteristics
Talk about weather in Cameroon and around the world
Use time expressions (today, tomorrow, yesterday)
Form questions using do and does
Answer yes/no questions correctly
Ask and answer questions about daily routines
Use question words (what, where, when, who, why)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Use past simple with regular and irregular verbs to talk about past events

objectifsLesson.description: Conjugate regular verbs in past simple (-ed)
Use past time expressions (yesterday, last week, ago)
Tell about one's day yesterday
Ask questions in the past (Did you...?)
Memorize the most common irregular verbs (go-went, eat-ate, see-saw)
Talk about childhood memories
Use negative forms in past simple (didn't)
Tell a simple story about past experiences

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Use 'will' and 'going to' to talk about future plans and predictions

objectifsLesson.description: Use 'will' to make predictions and spontaneous decisions
Form affirmative, negative, and interrogative with 'will'
Talk about future ambitions and goals
Make promises and offers using 'will'
Use 'going to' for planned intentions
Differentiate between 'will' and 'going to'
Talk about future travel plans
Discuss future career and personal goals

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Name body parts, describe symptoms, and express feelings and emotions

lessons.titreLesson: Parts of the Body and Health

objectifsLesson.description: Name parts of the human body
Describe symptoms to a doctor (I have a headache, fever)
Use 'have got' and 'has got' correctly
Ask for medical help and understand basic advice
Name common emotions (happy, sad, angry, tired, worried)
Use adjectives and adverbs to describe feelings
Express empathy and react to others' emotions
Talk about what makes you feel certain emotions

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Name professions, describe job responsibilities, and participate in a job interview

objectifsLesson.description: Name various professions and workplaces
Differentiate between present simple and present continuous
Describe one's current job or future career
Talk about daily work routines
Present oneself professionally
Talk about skills, qualifications, and experience
Answer common interview questions
Participate in a mock job interview

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Discuss technology, use logical connectors, and communicate via phone and messages

objectifsLesson.description: Name applications, devices, and social media platforms
Use logical connectors (and, but, because, so, however)
Explain how to use an application or device
Discuss advantages and disadvantages of technology
Use polite telephone expressions
Leave and take phone messages
Use the imperative to give instructions
Simulate professional and personal phone calls

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Discuss cultural events, use 'used to', and compare traditions

objectifsLesson.description: Name festivals and celebrations (Christmas, Eid, New Year, weddings)
Describe how festivals are celebrated
Use 'used to' to talk about past habits
Share personal experiences of celebrations
Compare Cameroonian and English-speaking cultures
Use comparative and superlative forms
Discuss cultural differences and similarities
Express opinions about cultural practices

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Discuss entertainment preferences, use gerunds, and give opinions

objectifsLesson.description: Name music and film genres
Use like, love, hate + -ing (gerund)
Give opinions about movies and songs
Recommend entertainment to others
Describe plots and characters in simple terms
Discuss preferences in music and movies
Understand simple song lyrics
Make plans to watch a movie or attend a concert

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Understand news vocabulary, use passive voice, and summarize information

objectifsLesson.description: Understand basic journalistic vocabulary
Read and understand simple news articles
Use passive voice in simple sentences
Summarize a news story in a few sentences
Express opinions about current events
Use conditional simple (would, could, should)
Agree and disagree politely
Participate in simple debates on social issues

chapitres.titreChapitre: Achieving Intermediate Level: Autonomy and Review
chapitres.competenceChapitre: Hold 10-15 minute conversations, understand general meaning of audio, write coherent texts, and reach A2+/B1 level

objectifsLesson.description: Review present simple and present continuous
Review past simple and future forms
Combine different tenses in conversation
Identify the appropriate tense for different contexts
Hold a 10-15 minute conversation on familiar topics
Ask open and closed questions
Respond spontaneously to conversation partners
Use varied thematic vocabulary appropriately
Understand the A2+/B1 level test format
Review essential grammar points
Practice with exam-type exercises
Complete a final presentation in English
